text:
Dear Daniel,

Thank you for your email, and we look forward to welcoming you and your dogs on 13 November (booking ML-2015).

Pets: We are dog-friendly, with a maximum of two dogs per room, so your two dogs are welcome. The pet fee is $50 per night per room, capped at $200 per stay [P1]. Pet fees do not earn loyalty points [P2].

Early check-in: Standard check-in is 3:00 PM [P7]. Early check-in depends on which rooms are ready and cannot be guaranteed in advance [P6]. We have asked our front desk to check whether your cabin can be ready early, and they will confirm with you.

Airport shuttle: Our shuttle to and from Asheville Regional Airport costs $35 per person one way and runs hourly from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM [P10]. We have asked our concierge team to book three seats for your Friday arrival around 11:00 AM and will confirm the pickup time with you.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

Hola Sofía,

Gracias por escribirnos. Hemos localizado su reserva ML-2021 (Standard Queen, Habitación 104, viernes 20 y sábado 21 de noviembre de 2026, check-out domingo 22).

Sobre el desayuno: sí, un desayuno continental está incluido en cada tarifa, servido de 7:00 a 10:00 AM en el Great Room [P1].

Sobre su gato: lamentablemente, en Mountain Lodge no se admiten gatos ni otras mascotas, aunque sí somos adecuados para perros [P4]. Si desea, el equipo puede ayudarle a buscar alternativas.

Quedamos a su disposición.

Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

Hello Laura,

Thank you for reaching out about your December trip. Unfortunately, our dog policy allows dogs up to 40 lbs, with a maximum of 2 dogs per room, so a 60 lb Labrador is not permitted [P1]. Dogs are also not allowed at the pool or in the restaurant [P1]. Service animals are always welcome with no fee [P1].

Parking is valet only, at $45 per night with in/out privileges [P6].

Yes, there is a resort fee of $35 per night plus tax. It includes Wi-Fi, bike rental and two bottles of water per day [P4].

If you have any questions, please reply to this email and we will be happy to help.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

Hi Daniel,

Thank you for your email, and we look forward to welcoming you and your dogs on 13 November (booking ML-2015).

Pets: We are dog-friendly. Dogs of any size are welcome, up to 2 per room, and the pet fee is $50 per night per room, capped at $200 per stay [P1]. Your two dogs fit within that limit. Dog beds and bowls are available on request.

Early check-in: Standard check-in is 3:00 PM [P8]. Early check-in depends on which rooms are ready and cannot be guaranteed in advance [P6]. We have passed your noon request to our front desk, who will confirm. Early check-in before 12 PM carries a $25 fee if the room is ready [P7].

Airport shuttle: Our shuttle to and from Asheville Regional Airport is $35 per person one way. It runs hourly on the hour from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM and must be booked at least 12 hours ahead [P11]. We have sent your request for three guests arriving around 11:00 AM on Friday, and our team will confirm the booking with you.

Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

Dear Mia,

Thank you for your message. We'd be happy to arrange a couples massage for you during your stay (9–12 November).

The Couples Massage (60 min) is $340 per treatment [P1]. A 20% service charge is added automatically [P6]. As a Gold Guest Rewards member, you receive 10% off treatments Monday to Thursday [P6], so Tuesday 10 November qualifies. The team will confirm the final total for you.

Spa hours are 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM daily, and bookings should be made at least 24 hours ahead [P2]. I've passed your request for a Tuesday afternoon slot to our spa team, who will confirm the available time with you.

A manager will review nothing further on this request; our team will be in touch shortly.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

Dear Zoe,

Thank you for letting us know, and I'm sorry the noise disturbed your rest.

We have rooms free for Mon 2 and Tue 3 Nov (checkout Wed 4 Nov): Standard Queen at $189 per night, Cabin at $249 per night, and Suite at $369 per night. Availability isn't a reservation, and any room change is subject to approval. I've passed your request to a manager, who will review it and reply. Our front desk team will also call you to discuss options and look into the noise.

For reference, quiet hours at the Mountain Lodge run from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM [P3].

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

Hello Laura,

If you'd like to check December availability, just let us know your dates and we'll be happy to help.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

Hello Sarah,

Thank you for getting in touch. I found your booking BR-1047 (Standard King, Room 203, arriving Fri 13 Nov and departing Sun 15 Nov).

Standard King rooms are available for the night of Sun 15 Nov at $289 per night (flexible rate). I've sent your extension request to a manager, who will review it and reply. Staff will confirm the final total.

For check-out on Monday: standard check-out is 11:00 AM [P5]. As a Silver member, you are entitled to late check-out until 1:00 PM at no charge, subject to availability [P2][P3]. Our weekend late check-out limit applies to Saturdays and Sundays only, so it does not affect Monday [P1]. I've also asked our front desk to note your request.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

Hello Daniel,

Thank you for your email, and we look forward to welcoming you for your stay from 13 to 16 November (booking ML-2015).

Pets: We're dog-friendly, with a maximum of two dogs per room, so your two dogs are welcome. The pet fee is $50 per night per room, capped at $200 per stay [P1]. The team will confirm your total.

Early check-in: Our standard check-in is 3:00 PM [P7]. Early check-in depends on which rooms are ready and can't be guaranteed in advance [P6]. We've passed your request to the front desk, who will confirm whether an earlier arrival is possible and any fee.

Airport shuttle: The shuttle to and from Asheville Regional Airport is $35 per person one way. It runs hourly from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM and must be booked at least 12 hours ahead [P10]. We've requested a pickup for your three guests at 11:00 AM on Friday. Please send your flight number and arrival time so we can confirm the booking.

Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

text:
Hello Daniel,

Thank you for your email, and we look forward to welcoming you for your stay from 13 to 16 November (booking ML-2015).

Pets: We're dog-friendly, with a maximum of two dogs per room, so your two dogs are welcome. The pet fee is $50 per night per room, capped at $200 per stay [P1]. The team will confirm your total.

Early check-in: Our standard check-in is 3:00 PM [P7]. Early check-in depends on which rooms are ready and can't be guaranteed in advance [P6]. We've passed your request to the front desk, who will confirm whether an earlier arrival is possible and any fee.

Airport shuttle: The shuttle to and from Asheville Regional Airport is $35 per person one way. It runs hourly from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM and must be booked at least 12 hours ahead [P10]. We've requested a pickup for your three guests at 11:00 AM on Friday. Please send your flight number and arrival time so we can confirm the booking.

Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

Hola Sofía,

Gracias por escribirnos. Tenemos su reserva ML-2021 (Standard Queen, del viernes 20 al domingo 22 de noviembre de 2026).

Sobre el desayuno: sí, un desayuno continental está incluido en todas las tarifas de habitación, servido de 7:00 a 10:00 AM en el Great Room [P1].

Sobre su gato: lamentablemente no podemos aceptar gatos ni otras mascotas que no sean perros [P4]. Somos un alojamiento pet-friendly solo para perros, de cualquier tamaño (máximo 2 por habitación, con tarifa de $50 por noche) [P4].

Si tiene alguna otra pregunta, con gusto le ayudamos.

Un cordial saludo,
Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

text:
Hello Owen,

Thank you for letting us know, and I'm sorry the connection is dropping during your work calls. We've asked our maintenance team to check the Wi-Fi in Cabin C5.

Wi-Fi is free for all guests. The network is MountainLodge-Guest, and the password is printed on your key card sleeve. The signal is weaker in the cabins, and a free range extender is available at the front desk [P1]. We've also asked the front desk to offer you one.

If the problem continues, please reply and tell us the times it drops, so we can look into it further.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Mountain Lodge
